summary: Purple Biotech Ltd., an Israeli clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, reporting its second-quarter 2026 financial results and business updates. The filing includes a press release and unaudited interim financial statements as of June 30, 2026. It announces total cash of $6.1 million, providing runway through mid-2027, and highlights new preclinical data for its IM1240 tri-specific antibody. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review is mentioned. The filing is a routine periodic report, not a special situation.
